proposal.reason: Primary change is communicator-level configuration controls: new config fields are validated, defaulted, env-overridden, stored on comm, and synchronized across ranks in init/lifecycle paths. enqueue is additionally required because graphUsageMode now changes strong-stream acquire/release and capture handling (including mixed graph/non-graph behavior) used during enqueue/channel setup. transport is additionally required because nChannelsPerNetPeer/maxP2pPeers now directly affect P2P network channel-per-peer budgeting and peer-concurrency limits used for transport channel allocation.
